The letters and words on profiles, in plain language. A joke, then the point. This is not a diagnosis and not a textbook. We do not replace a doctor. Self-diagnosis is welcome on WIRING.
Tap a tag in the feed for the short version. Here is the same thing, with room to actually read it.
ASD — аутизм. Мир приходит слишком громк: ASD means autism. The world arrives too loud, too bright, or by its own rules.
Тишина, темнота и одна тема на весь вече: Quiet, dark, and one topic for the whole evening. Small talk is a paid quest. A special interest is not a hobby. It is a power outlet.
ADHD — СДВГ. Внимание прыгает, кнопка «п: ADHD. Attention jumps, and the button labeled just focus does not work.
В голове сто вкладок, и одна орёт. Дедла: A hundred browser tabs in your head, and one of them is yelling. A deadline can switch on a superpower. Chores cannot. This is not laziness.
AuDHD means autism and ADHD in the same person.
Хочется расписание и тут же от него сбеж: You want a schedule and then immediately want to escape it. You need quiet, and you also need it not to be boring. Combo.
BPD — ПРЛ. Чувства очень сильные и перек: BPD. Feelings are very strong and switch fast.
От «ты лучший» до «меня бросят» может хв: One chat can go from you are the best to I am about to be left. That is not being too dramatic. That is how the nervous system is wired.
OCD — ОКР. Навязчивые мысли и ритуалы, к: OCD. Intrusive thoughts and rituals that loosen the anxiety for a minute.
Мозг говорит «проверь ещё раз», хотя ты: Your brain says check again, even though you already did. Just don't think about it is like just don't sneeze.
БАР — биполярное расстройство. Настроени: Bipolar disorder. Mood moves in big waves. It is not a vibe you pick for the evening.
Сначала режим прайма, потом серый подвал: First it is prime time, then a grey basement. Around and around, with no pick a mood button.
CPTSD — комплексное ПТСР. След долгой тр: CPTSD, complex PTSD. The mark of a long trauma, not one bad day.
Тело живёт так, будто опасность ещё здес: The body lives as if the danger is still here. Trust builds slowly. Just forget it does not fix that.
PTSD — ПТСР. После травмы прошлое включа: PTSD. After trauma, the past switches on as if it is happening now.
Флешбэк — не «вспомнил грустное». Тело р: A flashback is not I remembered something sad. The body reacts as if it is happening again.
Тревожное расстройство. Тревога крутится: An anxiety disorder. The worry keeps spinning, with almost no off switch.
В голове уже десять плохих концовок, хот: Your head already has ten bad endings, and nothing has happened. Don't worry is not treatment.

Три человека в комнате уже концерт. Хоче: Three people in a room is already a concert. You want to mute the room and yourself. This is not just shy.
Депрессия — силы и радость пропадают над: Depression: energy and joy disappear for a long time. It is not sadness for one evening.
